items.proposition: NuEbyon describes itself as an emerging AI-first software company aiming to build tools, products, and knowledge for other AI-first businesses, with an intended portfolio extending beyond one application.
items.materiality: Establishes the broad company ambition and intended audience that make the first product a starting point rather than the whole vision.
items.boundary: States an ambition and intended direction, not an established portfolio or demonstrated business outcome.

items.proposition: The intended direction is reusable products and capabilities for a broader audience, rather than primarily traditional consultancy or bespoke software for individual clients.
items.materiality: Clarifies the product-oriented character of the company vision.
items.boundary: Does not establish a finalized commercial model, customer segment, or distribution strategy.

items.proposition: NuEbyon is at an early stage; NuEbyon.Compose is its first concrete product direction, while the broader portfolio and operating model remain under development.
items.materiality: Anchors the broad ambition in one concrete starting point while preserving the distinction between the company vision and its first product direction.
items.boundary: Does not establish that Compose is commercially available or that other products are implemented.

items.proposition: NuEbyon identifies other AI-first companies—businesses placing AI at the center of products, operations, or business models—as its intended audience, and aims to provide them with tools, capabilities, and knowledge.
items.materiality: Supports describing whom the company intends to serve.
items.boundary: An intended audience is not evidence of customers, market validation, or established demand.

items.proposition: Compose is designed to turn ideas and accumulated knowledge into useful, well-structured content through an AI-native orchestration workflow, organized as Idea → Discover and Select → Research → Synthesize → Narrative → Compose.
items.materiality: Makes the first product direction specific and shows how it relates to the broader ambition.
items.boundary: Describes the product's purpose and designed stages; it does not show that every stage is implemented or that the workflow has demonstrated effectiveness.

items.proposition: The source attributes a content-integrity role to Compose's staged process: content should come from researched and organized source material; upstream stages shape what can truthfully be said, while composition shapes how that material is presented.
items.materiality: Preserves the stated distinction between developing/supporting content and presenting it.
items.boundary: This is a stated process principle, not evidence that outputs are necessarily truthful, complete, or accurate.

items.proposition: NuEbyon presents coordinated workflows and specialized agents as an architectural direction: complex tasks may be divided among agents with distinct responsibilities, coordinated by an orchestration layer; this approach is central to Compose's development.
items.materiality: Supports describing orchestration as part of the product direction and its broader technical approach.
items.boundary: The source characterizes an approach and development direction, not a measured advantage over other architectures.

items.proposition: The source says the strategic needs it identifies have not necessarily been validated and the proposed solutions have not demonstrated effectiveness; it also cautions that the architecture alone is not proof of superior performance, lower costs, or improved productivity.
items.materiality: Prevents the stated rationale or architecture from being converted into claims of validated demand or proven benefits.
items.boundary: Does not establish that the needs or solutions are ineffective; it states that validation or demonstrated effects are not claimed here.

items.proposition: The source says customer segments, commercial model, and distribution strategy are not finalized, and cautions against implying an established customer base or commercially available portfolio.
items.materiality: Limits any account of the company's current market presence or commercial status.
items.boundary: Does not prove that no customer conversations or other activity exist; it only says not to present an established base or available portfolio as fact.

items.proposition: Compose's current development focus is a deliberately narrow implementation of its core workflow; automatic publication is not part of the current implementation.
items.materiality: Separates the product's intended content workflow and possible broader offering from current implementation scope.
items.boundary: Does not specify exactly which workflow stages are implemented or imply that publication could never be added.

items.proposition: The source lists additional directions—including broader content formats, agent orchestration, knowledge processing, social-media automation, CAD automation, and AI-supported entrepreneurship—as explored or potential portfolio areas.
items.materiality: Supports the claim that the ambition could extend beyond Compose while preserving the exploratory status of the additional directions.
items.boundary: These are not all implemented, commercially available, or committed products; the source explicitly treats them as possibilities requiring further development and validation.

items.proposition: The broader structured-knowledge concept has been explored in the content workflow, but its application across the company portfolio remains under development rather than an established company-wide capability.
items.materiality: Limits how broadly knowledge capabilities can be attributed to NuEbyon today.
items.boundary: Does not deny that a knowledge-layer concept has been explored within the content workflow.

items.proposition: NuEbyon's stated AI-first positioning has two dimensions: AI is intended to be fundamental to its products and central to how the company conceives, develops, and operates them. The stronger AI-only ambition has no defined operational meaning in the source.
items.materiality: Clarifies the meaning and limits of the identity claim central to the company's positioning.
items.boundary: Does not establish that all activities are already automated or that human involvement will be eliminated; the source explicitly cautions against those implications.

items.proposition: The roadmap is described as development priorities, not a fixed release schedule: first focus on Compose, then explore expanded content and reusable capabilities, with a broader portfolio as a later possibility.
items.materiality: Preserves the sequence and provisional character of the roadmap.
items.boundary: No launch dates or commercial availability commitments are established.

items.proposition: NuEbyon describes its development principle as starting with a focused problem, establishing a working product, learning through development and use, and expanding when there is a clear reason; Compose is the first step giving the broader vision a concrete expression.
items.materiality: Connects the focused product starting point to the broader ambition without treating every possible direction as inevitable.
items.boundary: Describes an intended development principle, not a reported result of validated learning or a fixed commitment to expand.

ideaChecks.proposition: NuEbyon aims to build products and capabilities for other AI-first companies.
NuEbyon's first concrete product direction is Compose, a structured workflow intended to turn ideas and accumulated knowledge into content.
The broad company ambition is grounded in Compose without implying that the wider portfolio already exists.

limitations: The source is a company-positioning brief describing intentions, proposed directions, and development priorities; it supplies no independent validation or measured product outcomes.
The source distinguishes Compose's intended workflow from its narrow current implementation but does not specify which individual workflow stages are already implemented.
The exact operational meaning of the AI-only ambition remains undefined in the source.
